name: record-header
title: Record header
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Breadcrumb, title, status, meta, people, and actions for one record. page-header remains the scrolling page fold.

meta.descriptionEs: Miga, título, estado, meta, personas y acciones de un registro.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
